move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer; it sounds like this project matters beyond the immediate order. We recognise the strain our late payments have caused and will ensure payment is made as agreed. How far can you improve your pricing in return for a shorter payment cycle?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
